title: C gradient: adaptive_sf_select step-3 density threshold 10 -> 8 (spec 02a 2a.8)
description: Smallest child of b7z9.30. Spec 02a-coordinated-capacity.md 2a.8 procedure step 3: 'IF (Density > 8) OR (Utilization > 150) THEN SF = MIN(12, SF + 2)'. C impl lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/gradient.c uses 'density > 10' (~line 317). Neither ccp16.json nor ccp_load_balancing.json pins this path (verified: their vectors cover select_channel/TDMA/guard/drift only), so the spec text is the oracle. Fix the constant to 8 and update the C unit tests that exercise sf_select (find via grep lichen_gradient_sf_select in lichen/tests/). Note: step-4's extra upgrade_count hysteresis and the absent post-step-6 floors are separate children; the parent's 'loss threshold 40%' claim is STALE (both C gradient.c:291 and Rust rf_health.rs already implement 0.25 with ccp16_ema_loss_threshold vectors). Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.30.
